ch.s: This chapter covers: The apostle blesses God for the growing state of the love and patience of the Thessalonians (vv. 1–4); And encourages them to persevere under all their sufferings for Christ, considering his coming at the great day of account (vv. 5–12). People named: Paul, Silvanus, Timotheus.
ch.mh: Where there is the truth of grace, there will be an increase of it.
q: Read verses 1–4 (The apostle blesses God for the growing state of the love and patience of the Thessalonians). What is happening, and what stands out to you most?
In verses 5–12 (And encourages them to persevere under all their sufferings for Christ, considering his coming at the great day of account), what do you learn about suffering and endurance?
Verse 8 is one of the most cross-referenced verses in this chapter. Read it alongside 1 Peter 4:17. How do the two passages shed light on each other?
What does Paul’s part in this chapter teach you — as an example to follow or a warning to heed?
Where do you see the theme of faith and trust in this chapter, and how does it connect to the rest of 2 Thessalonians?
What is one specific way you can put this chapter into practice this week?
ch.a: Bring a present hardship to God and memorize the key verse as an anchor.

ch.s: This chapter covers: Cautions against the error that the time of Christ's coming was just at hand. There would first be a general apostasy from the faith, and a revealing of the antichristian man of sin (vv. 1–4); His destruction, and that of those who obey him (vv. 5–12); The security of the Thessalonians from apostacy; an exhortation to stedfastness, and prayer for them (vv. 13–17). People named: Satan.
ch.mh: If errors arise among Christians, we should set them right; and good men will be careful to suppress errors which rise from mistaking their words and actions.
q: Read verses 1–4 (Cautions against the error that the time of Christ's coming was just at hand. There would first be a general apostasy from the faith, and a revealing of the antichristian man of sin). What is happening, and what stands out to you most?
In verses 5–12 (His destruction, and that of those who obey him), what do you learn about the church and fellowship?

ch.aq: And we should pray in his name unto God, not only as his Father, but as our Father in and through him.
ch.a: Ask God to search your heart, confess what He shows you, and make any right amends.

o: The apostle expresses confidence in the Thessalonians, and prays for them.
He charges them to withdraw from disorderly walkers, particularly from the lazy and busybodies.
And concludes with a prayer for them, and a greeting.

ch.s: This chapter covers: The apostle expresses confidence in the Thessalonians, and prays for them (vv. 1–5); He charges them to withdraw from disorderly walkers, particularly from the lazy and busybodies (vv. 6–15); And concludes with a prayer for them, and a greeting (vv. 16–18). ch.mh: Those who are far apart still may meet together at the throne of grace; and those not able to do or receive any other kindness, may in this way do and receive real and very great kindness.
